regions.full_page: bad example. Jesus Himself assures us, "It is neces- sary that scandals come, " nevertheless, woe to that man by whom scandal cometh. What are we to do? Ah, dear Br. one thing is certain: for many reasons and in many ways we shall have to have patience. We shall have to wait till the time of the harvest which usual- ly comes before people expect it. We shall have to wait till the day of particular judgement at least when the cockle of sin and of passion shall have been purged away and our souls tried in tribulation and sanctified in the Blood of Jesus Christ. In the mean time, however, dear Br. we must try with God's grace to realize more and more, the obstacles in the way of our salvation on the one hand and on the other our un- speakable privileges. No man can afford to be idle while waiting for harvest - the great Judgement day.
